name: ShowFloor_5
short_caption: The robot briefly sweeps both hands down toward its base to point out the floor or ground.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly brings both arms inward and downward, pointing its hands toward the lower base. It holds this downward-pointing gesture briefly while maintaining a steady forward head gaze. Finally, it retracts both arms back to its sides, returning to the default neutral standing pose.
safety_notes: The arms sweep inward and downward close to the torso and base; ensure the immediate low frontal area of the robot is free of obstacles.
